summary: Revoked runtime starts no longer hold a seat forever behind a terminal PTY row without a PID: retirement requires positive closure proof for the revoked operation's producer and work scopes, even when the retained row belongs to an older operation

replay.detail: No graph replay; reconciliation rechecks retained revoked starts.

schema.detail: No database schema change or registry row deletion.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire contract change. Non-terminal incarnation-less rows remain blocked and now record a diagnostic; terminal rows retire only with operation-fenced producer closure evidence.

manual.detail: No ledger edits or registry cleanup required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous conservative retention of terminal incarnation-less rows.
